structure: Overview: a volunteer clean-up along a creek on a sunny day; read the banner.
Back: the registration tent, then the man in the creek with the shopping cart, the ducks and the tire.
Foreground left to right: the woman with the litter grabber and the boy, the photographer, the bins and bags, the man with the shovel.
Wrap-up: one sentence about the community spirit.
modelAnswer: This picture shows a volunteer clean-up along a creek on a sunny day. On the left, there's a red tent with a banner that says "Salmon Creek Clean-Up," and under it, a volunteer in an orange safety vest is handing something orange, probably a vest, to a man in blue who seems to have just arrived. In the middle of the creek, a man in a cap is standing in the water and hauling an old shopping cart out of it, while two ducks swim nearby. In the foreground on the left, a woman is using a litter grabber to pick up a can, and a little boy is holding open a black garbage bag for her. Next to them, a woman in green is taking a photo with her phone. In the centre, there are two bins, one for recycling and one for garbage, next to a pile of full bags. Finally, on the right, an older man is holding a shovel next to a young tree that has just been planted. It's a really positive, community-minded scene.

usefulExpressions.expression: …is handing something orange, probably a vest, to…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Gọi tên vật một cách thận trọng khi hình vẽ nhỏ: 'something + màu, probably…'.

usefulExpressions.expression: …hauling an old shopping cart out of it
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'haul … out of' = kéo mạnh một vật nặng ra khỏi — động từ mạnh, chính xác.

usefulExpressions.expression: …is holding open a black garbage bag for her
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'hold open' + 'for someone' để tả hai người phối hợp làm một việc.

usefulExpressions.expression: …one for recycling and one for garbage
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Cấu trúc 'one for … and one for …' để tả hai vật giống nhau có chức năng khác nhau.

usefulExpressions.expression: …a young tree that has just been planted
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành với 'just' — diễn tả việc vừa hoàn thành.

usefulExpressions.expression: It's a really positive, community-minded scene.
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Tính từ ghép 'community-minded' (có tinh thần cộng đồng) để kết bài.

commonMistakes: Gọi dòng suối là 'river' hoặc 'sea'; trong tranh banner ghi 'Creek' — dùng 'creek' hoặc 'stream'.
Nói 'a man is taking a shopping cart' — thiếu sắc thái; dùng 'pulling/hauling … out of the water'.
Nhầm 'garbage bag' và 'garbage bin'; túi là 'bag', thùng là 'bin'.
